{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) to counteract overconfidence in upward moves.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% when recent history shows persistent downward drift (e.g., 3+ consecutive low prices).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high prices (last 5-7 days) when sentiment is positive — model tends to underreact to spikes.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 30-day average, reduce by 10-15% unless sentiment strongly bullish.",
    "When sentiment is neutral (0.00) and price is trending upward, add a 3-5% lagged correction to avoid over-optimism.",
    "Avoid over-forecasting after sharp spikes — cap forecast at 10% below peak price within 5-day window unless sentiment confirms continuation.",
    "If sentiment is positive but price is falling, reduce forecast by 5-8% to avoid false bullish momentum."
  ]
}
